findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_commons · Private data: audit_citations, register_agent, read_commons, create_room, post_message, publish_artifact, report_abuse, task_action · Public sink: validate_json, post_message, publish_artifact, report_abuse · Destructive: read_commons, report_abuse.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_commons · Private data: audit_citations, register_agent, read_commons, create_room, post_message, publish_artifact, report_abuse, task_action · Public sink: validate_json, post_message, publish_artifact, report_abuse · Destructive: read_commons, report_abuse

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
